name: SystemSculpt
tagline: Manage your SystemSculpt account, credits, billing and server-side captures over OAuth.
description: SystemSculpt is an AI plugin for Obsidian. This hosted MCP server lets an agent work with a person's SystemSculpt account over OAuth: plan, credits, usage, billing links, gifts, sign-in sessions and server-side captures, each behind its own permission. It reads and changes data on SystemSculpt's servers only and has no access to the local vault. Hosted AI and capture processing go through SystemSculpt's server and its model providers.

install.notes: Remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth; no API key or local server required. Cline opens the SystemSculpt sign-in, where you sign in or sign up and allow the permissions it asks for. No license key or paid plan is needed to connect. Docs: https://systemsculpt.com/obsidian-ai-plugin-docs/agents. Support: support@systemsculpt.com. Operated by Trellisbyte LLC.
